title: Anthropic Prompt Engineering Interactive Tutorial
description: Official nine-chapter interactive tutorial that teaches Claude prompting with ordered lessons, playgrounds, and exercises. Free to follow; API usage may incur provider charges.
relevance_rationale: The entire curriculum is dedicated prompt-engineering technique practice for Claude.

title: Anthropic Prompt Evaluations
description: Official Anthropic courses material focused on evaluating prompts and LLM outputs through guided exercises rather than a marketed certificate track. Practice resource, not a conventional standalone course.
relevance_rationale: Exercises center on prompt evaluation design and judging Claude outputs.

title: Build Effective Generative AI Solutions in Your Organization
description: Microsoft Learn module with ordered units on prompting, grounding, trust, and when to use machine learning. A signed-in module assessment can add a pass designation to a Learn profile; that is not a formal certification.
relevance_rationale: Includes an explicit prompt-engineering unit inside a broader generative-AI leadership module.

title: Azure OpenAI Exercises
description: Guided lab exercises that support Microsoft Learn Azure OpenAI modules. Useful practice material, not a standalone certificate-bearing course.
relevance_rationale: Labs practice prompting and Azure OpenAI application patterns that accompany Learn modules.

title: Beginner: Introduction to Generative AI
description: Official Google Skills learning path titled Beginner: Introduction to Generative AI. It bundles introductory microlearning courses plus a separate Prompt Design in Agent Platform skill-badge activity. Completing the path overview itself is not evidenced as awarding a path-level skill badge; confirm any assessed badge on the specific activity page. Some lab activities may require Google Skills credits or a subscription.
relevance_rationale: Path includes prompt design practice among broader generative-AI and responsible-AI introductions on Google Cloud.

title: NVIDIA Generative AI and LLM Learning Path
description: Official NVIDIA learning-path landing page that lists multiple free and paid DLI courses and workshops, including Building LLM Applications With Prompt Engineering. The path itself is not one single enrolled course and does not award a path-level credential.
relevance_rationale: Path explicitly includes a dedicated prompt-engineering LLM application course among broader generative-AI offerings.

title: ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers
description: Short structured course by Isa Fulford and Andrew Ng covering prompt principles and API-based tasks such as summarizing, inferring, transforming, expanding, and chatbot building. Course learning access is currently offered free; a graded assignment and resume accomplishment require the paid PRO plan. Issuer wording describes an accomplishment, not a certificate.
relevance_rationale: The course is purpose-built to teach prompt engineering for developer workflows with OpenAI APIs.

title: Foundations of Prompt Engineering
description: Official AWS Skill Builder digital course covering prompt fundamentals through advanced techniques and misuse defenses. Listed access is Free with sign-in required to enroll. The course includes eLearning interactions and is not a certification exam. Related AWS certifications remain separate paid exams.
relevance_rationale: AWS positions the digital course as dedicated prompt-engineering training from basics through advanced techniques.
